notes.title: Difficulty increase, Garlic, Winter GameFest, and more!
notes.content:
[h1]Preheat your oven to 375° because this update is going to be tasty![/h1]

Greetings garlic bread lovers, 

In this update we are proud to honor the latest and most tasty Crypto currency around, Garlic Coin! You can now get a special hat skin to up your fashion to infinity. Just type in the secret code on the main menu to activate it!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30453954/73ceffb1686ad363a824d2e1ce92f5b7633731ae.jpg[/img]

[h1] Difficulty update[/h1]

After a few months of play testing and keeping a close eye on the leader-boards it was obvious the game was too easy. We have upped the difficulty in several ways to give players a greater sense of pride and accomplishment for getting high scores! Don’t worry, no micro transactions! with this update there will be a reset of the high-scores to test this new difficulty.


[list]
    [*] Controls now move the moon with less force meaning you'll take a few extra seconds to reach maximum speed.
    [*] The planet people have added special moon melting focusing crystals to the laser which will cause it to slice through you like cheese. Watch out!
    [*] Consecutive revives are now harder to achieve. 
    [*] UFOs are now bigger and kill you in one hit. But they are also a little slower to compensate for the added payload they carry.
    [*] Enemy waves will last a bit longer making you face more rockets, tanks, and UFOs
    [*] Less health and powerup drops
[/list]

We are always looking for feedback on the game mechanics, difficulty, skills, and anything at all! If you have any suggestions, Feedback, or ideas please hop on discord and let us know!

[h1] UCSD’s Winter GameFest [/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30453954/ef1f18472e6de148b6856b28b8b8808824633f07.jpg[/img]

We will be showcasing Planet Bash at UCSD’s LaJolla, California campus on February 17th and 18th! If you’re in So Cal come on out for this free event. There will be tons of big name sponsors such as Razer, Blizzard, Tespa, MSI and more! There will also be tons of prizes, giveaways, and tournaments. 

 [url=https://www.facebook.com/wintergamefest/]For more info check their Facebook here[/url]

[h1] Bug Fixes and Additions [/h1]
[list]
    [*] Fixed some bugs that were left in from last update 
    [*] Added some bugs that will (hopefully) be fixed in the next update
[/list]

[h1]Community Discord[/h1]
 Our [url=Discord.gg/BigRedPlanet]Community Discord[/url] is the best place to keep up to date on all the news and to suggest things you would like to see added to Planet Bash!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30453954/01cca76a55cd878481ae1ea66219936dc5e56ca4.png[/img]

notes.title: Planet Bash bashes into the holidays!
notes.content:
[h1]Bash into the holidays with these updates![/h1]

Greetings planet destroyers,

We have added a small update for the holidays with a few updates, fixes, and changes!

[h1] Visual updates[/h1]
[list]
    [*] Check out the new Santa hat which is now the default hat.
    [*] Buildings on the planet are more festive
    [*] Mines will now trigger chain reaction explosions
[/list]

[h1] Bug Fixes and Additional updates[/h1]
[list]
    [*] Added in cloud save so you can play from any computer. 
    [*] Fixed mines not disappearing after exploding
    [*] Rebalanced the wave duration, food spawn rate, and ufo speed 
    [*] Made it so the shields don't add up infinitely, sorry guys. 
    [*] Changed the way the revive system works so repeat revives are harder
[/list]


[h1]Community Discord[/h1]
 Our [url=Discord.gg/BigRedPlanet]Community Discord[/url] is the best place to keep up to date on all the news and to suggest things you would like to see added to Planet Bash!

notes.title: E-sports Gaming world at the Los Angeles County Fair and Early Access!
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings Planet Bashers![/h1]

Over the past month We have been super hard at work adding in tons of new features to Planet Bash for you to Enjoy! For those of you who have played PB during the Limdum Dare 39 you'll be rejoiced to see many new additions to the game since the Itch.io version. 
 
[h1]Steam Integrations[/h1]
Planet Bash has been updated with all the new bells and whistles that come with Steam including:
[list]
[*] Leaderboards
[*] More Powerups
[*] 28 achievements
[*] Game stats and history
[/list]
And soon to come trading cards, emojis, backgrounds, and items!

[h1] Esports Gaming World[/h1]
For those of you in Southern California we invite you to the Esports Gaming world inside of The Los Angeles County fair. Big Red Planet will have a booth at the event on SEP 8-10. You'll be one of the first to play the game before it's released and will even have a chance to win the game for free! For more information on the event and ticket info please visit the Esports gaming world website:[url=http://www.esportsgamingworld.com] Here[/url]

[h1]Early Access[/h1]
Starting on Friday, Planet Bash will be available for Purchase via Steam Early Access! You will get first access to the game and will help choose the features we will add! Make sure to join the Discord and tell us what you want!

[h1]Community Discord[/h1]
Don't forget to join our [url=https://discord.gg/BigRedPlanet]Community Discord[/url] to keep up to date on development on all our games! It's also the fastest way to get a responce for any questions, comments, or feedback you have for Planet Bash.

You can also follow us on Twitter here: [url=https://twitter.com/BIGREDPLANETLLC] Twitter[/url]
